neutral.sample: The road out of town runs past the old grain elevator and the river. Most mornings it's quiet, just the wind and a few trucks heading for the highway. I've driven it so many times I could do it with my eyes closed.

angry.sample: I told you to stay out of my workshop, and you did it anyway!

sad.sample: I kept his letters. I just never had the heart to read them again.

excited.sample: We did it! The whole crop came in, every last row of it!
